name: Unexpected Type Element
essence: An existing receipt line changes its cents field to a string before collection formatting.

examples.summary: An existing receipt line changes its cents field to a string before collection formatting.
examples.mechanism: The mutable any field loses its numeric shape and the list consumer assumes every cents value implements toFixed.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: line.cents.toFixed is not a function
examples.expected_behavior: Validate the edit and print receipt 275.00.

ingredients.suggests: Editing a line overwrites the cents property on the same instance held in the list.
The list consumer calls toFixed on every cents value without checking its runtime shape.

examples.summary: An object in the receipt list changes its cents member to a string, breaking the consumer's assumed numeric contract..
examples.mechanism: An object in the receipt list changes its cents member to a string, breaking the consumer's assumed numeric contract.
examples.observed_output: ValueError: Unknown format code 'f' for object of type 'str'

ingredients.suggests: Editing a line changes the same instance already stored in the list.
The consumer formats every cents member as a number without checking its current shape.

examples.summary: Editing a line replaces numeric cents with a string consumed as an int.
examples.mechanism: An any field bypasses the static numeric contract; an unchecked type assertion fails after receiver mutation.
examples.observed_output: panic: interface conversion: interface {} is string, not int
examples.expected_behavior: Require numeric cents before formatting each receipt line.

ingredients.suggests: Editing mutates the same line instance held in the list.
The consumer asserts the runtime shape of every field without checking.

examples.summary: A mutated receipt line no longer has the shape its consumer expects.
examples.mechanism: Any type erasure and downcast provide the score-1 dynamic field escape hatch. Editing mutates the field of an instance already stored in the receipt list. The consumer assumes all dynamically typed line fields expose the same numeric type.
examples.expected_behavior: Every receipt line remains a numeric cents value.
